## *** NO qf_models ***
### - JUN protein group

```{r}
jun_accession <- "P05412"

jun_candidates <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  lapply(names(qf_models), function(software) {

    rd <- as.data.frame(
      SummarizedExperiment::rowData(
        qf_models[[software]][["proteins"]]
      )
    )

    # Match JUN accession as a complete identifier,
    # including within semicolon-separated protein groups
    hit <- grepl(
      paste0("(^|[;|])", jun_accession, "($|[;|])"),
      as.character(rd$Protein.Group)
    )

    # Also search Protein.Ids where available
    if ("Protein.Ids" %in% names(rd)) {
      hit <- hit | grepl(
        paste0("(^|[;|])", jun_accession, "($|[;|])"),
        as.character(rd$Protein.Ids)
      )
    }

    hit[is.na(hit)] <- FALSE

    data.frame(
      Software = software,
      Protein.Group = as.character(rd$Protein.Group[hit])
    )
  })
)

print(jun_candidates, row.names = FALSE)
```
### - p_jun

```{r}
# Keep candidate groups present in the protein assays
jun_groups <- jun_candidates

# Require one unambiguous JUN protein group per pipeline
stopifnot(
  nrow(jun_groups) == 4,
  all(table(jun_groups$Software) == 1)
)

jun_data <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  lapply(names(qf_models), function(software) {

    se <- qf_models[[software]][["proteins"]]

    protein_id <- jun_groups$Protein.Group[
      jun_groups$Software == software
    ]

    data.frame(
      Software = software,
      Run = colnames(se),
      Log2_Intensity = as.numeric(
        SummarizedExperiment::assay(se)[protein_id, ]
      )
    )
  })
) |>
  left_join(sample_design, by = "Run") |>
  mutate(
    Genotype = case_when(
      grepl("^CTRL_", Condition) ~ "CTRL",
      grepl("^KO_", Condition) ~ "KO",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Genotype = factor(Genotype, levels = c("CTRL", "KO")),
    Software = factor(Software, levels = names(qf_models))
  ) |>
  filter(
    !is.na(Genotype),
    grepl("Untreated|Baseline", Condition, ignore.case = TRUE)
  )

# Check sample coverage before plotting
jun_data |>
  group_by(Software, Batch, Genotype) |>
  summarise(
    Total = n(),
    Quantified = sum(is.finite(Log2_Intensity)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  print(n = Inf)

p_jun <- ggplot(
  jun_data,
  aes(
    x = Genotype,
    y = Log2_Intensity,
    color = Genotype
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.5,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.12,
    size = 2,
    alpha = 0.8,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  facet_grid(Software ~ Batch, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(CTRL = "#0072B2", KO = "#D55E00")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "JUN abundance across DIA pipelines",
    subtitle = "Untreated samples stratified by genotype and acquisition batch",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Normalized log2 JUN protein intensity"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )

print(p_jun)
```
### - p_jun_precursors

```{r}

jun_precursor_data <- bind_rows(
  lapply(names(qf_models), function(software) {

    se <- qf_models[[software]][["precursors_norm"]]
    rd <- as.data.frame(SummarizedExperiment::rowData(se))

    hit <- as.character(rd$Protein.Group) == "P05412"
    hit[is.na(hit)] <- FALSE

    if (!any(hit)) {
      warning("No JUN precursors found in ", software)
      return(NULL)
    }

    x <- SummarizedExperiment::assay(se)[hit, , drop = FALSE]

    data.frame(
      Software = software,
      Precursor = as.character(rd$Precursor.Id[hit])[
        row(x)
      ],
      Run = colnames(x)[col(x)],
      Log2_Intensity = as.vector(x)
    )
  })
) |>
  left_join(sample_design, by = "Run") |>
  mutate(
    Genotype = case_when(
      grepl("^CTRL_", Condition) ~ "CTRL",
      grepl("^KO_", Condition) ~ "KO",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Genotype = factor(Genotype, levels = c("CTRL", "KO")),
    Software = factor(Software, levels = names(qf_models))
  ) |>
  filter(
    !is.na(Genotype),
    grepl("Untreated|Baseline", Condition, ignore.case = TRUE)
  )

# Check how many JUN precursors each pipeline quantifies
jun_precursor_data |>
  group_by(Software) |>
  summarise(
    Precursors = n_distinct(Precursor),
    Quantified_measurements = sum(is.finite(Log2_Intensity)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  print(n = Inf)

p_jun_precursors <- ggplot(
  jun_precursor_data |>
    filter(is.finite(Log2_Intensity)),
  aes(
    x = Genotype,
    y = Log2_Intensity,
    color = Genotype
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.5,
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.15,
    size = 1.5,
    alpha = 0.65
  ) +
  facet_grid(Software ~ Batch, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(CTRL = "#0072B2", KO = "#D55E00")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "JUN precursor abundance across DIA pipelines",
    subtitle = "Untreated samples by genotype and acquisition batch",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Normalized log2 precursor intensity"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )

print(p_jun_precursors)
```

### - QC G4

```{r group4_biological_qc_figure, fig.width=15, fig.height=12}
# Consistent acquisition batch ordering
qc_batch_order <- c(
  "Group 1", "Group 2", "Group 3",
  "Group 4", "20260331"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# A. JUN protein abundance by genotype and acquisition batch
# ------------------------------------------------------------

p_qc_a <- ggplot(
  jun_data |>
    mutate(
      Batch = factor(as.character(Batch), levels = qc_batch_order),
      Software = factor(as.character(Software), levels = software_order)
    ),
  aes(x = Genotype, y = Log2_Intensity, color = Genotype)
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.5,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.12,
    size = 1.6,
    alpha = 0.8,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  facet_grid(Software ~ Batch, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(CTRL = "#0072B2", KO = "#D55E00")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Normalized log2 JUN protein intensity"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.spacing = grid::unit(0.7, "lines")
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# B. JUN peptide-level KO - CTRL effects
# ------------------------------------------------------------

p_qc_b <- ggplot(
  jun_peptide_effects |>
    mutate(
      Batch = factor(as.character(Batch), levels = qc_batch_order),
      Software = factor(as.character(Software), levels = software_order)
    ),
  aes(
    x = Batch,
    y = KO_minus_CTRL,
    group = Peptide,
    color = Peptide
  )
) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "gray50"
  ) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~Software, ncol = 2) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "JUN peptide difference (KO - CTRL)",
    color = "Peptide sequence"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8)
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# C. Leave-one-batch-out genotype signature validation
# ------------------------------------------------------------

p_qc_c <- ggplot(
  lobo_summary |>
    mutate(
      Batch = factor(as.character(Batch), levels = qc_batch_order),
      Software = factor(as.character(Software), levels = software_order)
    ),
  aes(
    x = Batch,
    y = KO_minus_CTRL,
    color = Software,
    group = Software
  )
) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "gray50"
  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = software_colors) +
  labs(
    x = "Held-out acquisition batch",
    y = "Genotype signature difference (KO - CTRL)",
    color = "Pipeline"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Composite QC figure
# ------------------------------------------------------------

qc_tag <- function(p, letter) {
  patchwork::wrap_elements(full = p) +
    labs(tag = letter) +
    theme(
      plot.tag = element_text(size = 25, face = "bold"),
      plot.tag.position = c(0, 1)
    )
}

fig_group4_qc <-
  qc_tag(p_qc_a, "A") /
  (qc_tag(p_qc_b, "B") | qc_tag(p_qc_c, "C")) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1.25, 1))

print(fig_group4_qc)

export_figure(
  fig_group4_qc,
  "Group4_Biological_QC_Exclusion",
  width = 15,
  height = 12
)
```
